title: Kura bundle registry
description: The portable bundle registry for the catalog at ~/.config/kura/catalog. A bundle exists for Kura only when this file names it, and its source is bundles/<name>/. Registered but absent directories remain representable for `kura list` and `kura doctor`. A present directory must contain bundle.json, at least one agents/*.md source and at least one skills/*/SKILL.md source. This schema describes registry rows, not bundle.json or owned source files.

$schema.description: URL or relative path of this schema.

version.description: Informational registry format version. Kura ignores it and does not negotiate compatibility.

upstream.description: Upstream repositories, keyed by GitHub owner/repo. This records bundle origin; `kura update` and `kura outdated` act only on skills.

local.description: Bundles authored in the catalog itself, without an upstream.

branch.description: Upstream ref recorded as metadata. Kura does not fetch bundles.

upstream_path.description: Bundle directory in the upstream repository. Its last component, or the repository name when empty, omitted, "." or "/", names the bundle unless `name` overrides it.

bundleName.description: One safe path component naming the bundle directory under the catalog's bundles/.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp recorded in the registry. Kura does not update bundle content.
